limits: Physics stable target starts after245 game worlds, V2 variants after244 due prior OUT assertion abort. V2/sensor abort on release80 recapture, so no observed81 in that family.

upper-lanes28 and ramp15 game+3 standalone predecessor worlds match before target across all variants. Preceding world trajectories may differ by geometry; world creation protocol/order is matched, not identical internal solver state.
Joint variant includes the four shared-solid substitutions and their collider assembly ordering. Does not separately isolate order from geometry.
